constraint_notes: IoU .5, containment .8, stride 2 are fixed candidate-family constraints evaluated on training; raw alternatives are included. Ties use listed order. No held-out or dev statistic enters selection.

decision.accept: training ACCEPT_FOR_COMPARISON and N > direct and N >= frozen constant and paired room-bootstrap lower bound > 0

response.format: per-category per-frame counts; selected count and frame
response.row_filter: K1 train only; truth >= 5; exact selected count equals truth
